articles.summary: SINGAPORE, Nov. 24, 2025 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Antalpha Platform Holding Company (NASDAQ: ANTA) ("Antalpha" or the "Company") today announced that its board of directors has authorized a share repurchase program of up to $10 million of the Company’s ordinary shares.
articles.title: Antalpha Announces $10 Million Share Repurchase Program
